sentences.back: Every morning before sunrise, the village baker begins his daily ritual, turning simple flour, water and yeast into food for the whole town.
His small shop sits on a cobblestone corner of the main square and is soon filled with the comforting baking smell of fermenting dough.
He works with skilled precision, kneading the heavy dough until it reaches the right elasticity needed for a perfect crust.
After the bread has risen, it is pushed into a huge stone oven, where intense heat bakes it golden.
Long before the sun reaches its highest point, the wooden counter is already laid out with rows of warm, crisp loaves.
Neighbors gather outside the door, drawn by the familiar aroma and the prospect of friendly chat.
For this craftsman, baking is not just a job but a vital craft that sustains and connects the community, providing a nourishing foundation for the day ahead.
